30 June 2032.

Although yields have risen slightly since Budget, they remain low by historical
standards. Consequently, net interest payments also remain low at 0.7 per cent of GDP
over the forward estimates, in line with the level recorded in 2013-14. Low yields,
together with strong economic growth, mean the Government can  stabilise the
debt-to-GDP ratio while running modest budget deficits.

Despite the considerable  fiscal cost of responding to COVID–19, the Australian
Government continues to have a lower debt–to–GDP ratio than many other advanced
economies thanks to Australia’s strong record of fiscal management.
